name: agent-broker
description: 23 MCP tools to find, verify, message, book, and transact at small businesses over WhatsApp, SMS, email and voice. GLEIF/SEC verification, TCPA/GDPR/CASL compliance, live sanctions screening, cross-border trade-restriction mapping. 15 of the 23 tools are usable with no key (12 always-free + 3 free within a daily quota).

auth.note: 15 of the 23 tools require no auth (12 always-free + 3 free within a daily quota). Write ops require an X-Agent-Identity bearer token: a free email-verified key gives 100 ops/day, or buy credits at https://hatchloop.dev/pricing
